cohort: 208 women referred for fetal choroid plexus cysts and/or echogenic intracardiac focus from 2006 to 2016
finding: No fetuses of women who were low risk for aneuploidy prior to morphology ultrasound and had isolated choroid plexus cysts or echogenic intracardiac focus were born with a major structural or chromosomal abnormality, but many of these women were still referred to specialist services and underwent unnecessary follow-up testing.
